svg.data-what: a lymph node in section: capsule, cortex with follicles, paracortex, medulla and hilum

path.data-what: the subcapsular sinus, under the capsule, where incoming lymph first spreads
the paracortex: the T cell zone, where dendritic cells show what they caught to T cells

g.data-what: medullary cords in the centre: strands of plasma cells, among others, between the sinuses draining toward the hilum
trabeculae: walls of connective tissue reaching in from the capsule
follicles in the outer cortex: B cell zones
germinal centres, the pale hearts of active follicles, where B cells multiply and sharpen their antibodies

path.data-what: the capsule of dense connective tissue around the node
the hilum, the notch where blood vessels enter and leave and lymph leaves
the artery entering at the hilum
the vein leaving at the hilum
the efferent lymph vessel, carrying lymph out of the node at the hilum

g.data-what: afferent lymph vessels, bringing lymph from the tissues into the node through its convex side
